subject: Advanced Coursework Completion Trends
overview: Lisa Kingsley presented a report on declining advanced coursework completion rates and emphasized the importance of data-driven strategies to ensure equitable access to challenging curricula.

items.title: Advanced Coursework Data and Access
items.summary: Lisa Kingsley reported a decrease in students completing advanced coursework from 48.8% to 42.3% and advocated for using data to ensure all students have access to college and career preparation.
